claude_proposed_widenings.name: activation-scoped equipment gate for timed benefits
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can represent charge-based activation, timed duration, grant_sense, and peering_through_item independently, but it cannot express that the granted Truesight is available only while peering through the gem during the 10-minute active window.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "For the next 10 minutes, you have Truesight out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem."
